description: The sprint-rhythm discipline that lets a user maintain a portfolio of in-flight projects, sprint rapidly between them, and resume any of them later from the exact phase it was parked at. Wraps project-bootstrap-v0 (and any other per-project standard) by treating each project as a nested execution whose state can be SHA-sealed, parked, and restored. Voice → spin → context-switch → return-later.

conductor_mode.description: The Claude Code thread the user is already in becomes the sprint conductor. When the user voices an in-flight thought, Claude reads this JSON, walks the phases[] in order, and tracks which project-slug is currently spun up. Each context-switch SHA-seals the prior project's state into .coltrane/portfolio.jsonl; each return-later restores from the sealed entry. The thread IS the sprint.
user_invocation_examples: I want to sprint across projects
I have multiple things in flight
conductor_protocol: 3. Per phase: execute `intent` conversationally — voice, spin, switch, restore
4. At each seam-with-seal: prompt user 'ready to seal? (yes/no/refine)' — yes → compute sha256_pre_verdict over the parked state + append portfolio.jsonl entry
5. The user may interject at any phase: voice a new in-flight thought, switch context, request resume of a parked slug
6. The portfolio is the durable surface — list at any time via /coltrane-portfolio

dispatch_mode.description: Same standard, different execution surface: the conductor uses Claude Code's Task tool with subagent_type=<phase.agent> to dispatch each sprint-phase to a separate Claude with the compiled .claude/agents/<phase.agent>.md system prompt. The user observes; the subagent runs the phase autonomously, returns parked-state or restored-state to conductor, conductor moves to next phase. Power-user surface — use when the spun project's work is heavy enough to warrant its own context window.
dispatch_mode.tradeoff: conductor_mode = lighter / portfolio + spun-project share one context. dispatch_mode = heavier / spun-project gets isolated context per phase / parallelizable if multiple projects are sprintable concurrently.

execution_modes.score_is_the_same: The standard JSON IS the score regardless of mode. conductor_mode reads it as a conversation script; dispatch_mode reads it as a phase-routing graph. Same file, two surfaces.

phases.name: voice
phases.intent: Listen. The user states an in-flight thought or intent. If no project is currently spun, create a parked draft entry. If a project IS spun, route the thought into that project's nested standard. The draft is mutable until a project-slug crystallizes — no seal yet.

phases.name: spin
phases.intent: Spin up the named project. The discover/define/develop work happens INSIDE the project's own bootstrap-v0 (or other nested) standard. This sprint-phase delegates: it loads the project's genome, hands control to that standard's conductor_protocol, and tracks current_phase in the portfolio entry. Seals fire per the nested standard's seal-seams, not this one's.

phases.name: context-switch
phases.intent: The user voices a DIFFERENT project's slug while one is currently spun. Capture the current sprint state (genome_slug, current_phase, current_standard_slug, ledger pointer), compute sha256 over the canonical-form serialization, append a parked entry to .coltrane/portfolio.jsonl with sealed_state_hash, then load the new project's genome and begin its spin-phase. The previous project is now parked + sealed; the new project is now current.

phases.name: return-later
phases.intent: The user voices a previously-parked slug. Read the latest portfolio entry for that slug, verify sealed_state_hash against the recorded state, restore current_phase and current_standard_slug, hand control back to the project's nested standard at the restored phase. If the seal does not verify, refuse to restore and surface SealMismatchError — the parked state has been tampered with.

seams_with_seal: context-switch -> return-later (sealed state is FROZEN; restoration verifies seal integrity)

safe_prereg_discipline.default: context-switch auto-seals the parked project's state with sha256. If the user opts to switch without sealing (e.g. for ephemeral experiments), the portfolio entry records sealed_state_hash=null and return-later surfaces WARN: 'restoring without seal — restoration is observation, not verification'.
safe_prereg_discipline.opt_in_tightening: Hard-gate restoration (refuse to resume if sealed_state_hash is null) is opt-in via portfolio-entry.seal_required = true.
